description: This Dart file defines two Flutter widget classes, 'LabeledField' and 'MaskedCardNumber', for forming UI components related to form input fields and card number display. 'LabeledField' provides a labeled input container with customizable placeholder, size, and styling. 'MaskedCardNumber' displays a masked card number with last 4 digits visible, styled for display purposes.

classes.name: LabeledField
classes.description: A customizable labeled input field widget with a label above a styled container that includes placeholder text.

classes.name: MaskedCardNumber
classes.description: A widget that displays a masked credit card number line with the last 4 digits visible.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the respective UI component.
